svg.title: Indeed substitute the nested alias formula in the sum, factor out the outer Y (PL,J,a) by periodicity, and use (LMv)−2 = L−2M−2 v . The empty history has F∅,af = f. Every renormalization step adds an independent local covariance k−1. Let Nv be the sum of the covariances of these noises propagated through their respective prefixes. More explicitly the empty history has no prefixes; extending a history introduces the empty prefix and extends each old prefix by the new patch. Thus
